reviews.title: Fatal Bug, No Fix, Waste of Money
reviews.text:
I have v4.4.4 of the app on iOS. When I download it I bought the $100 lifetime access, and that was a big mistake. One of the core selling points of the app is that it’s supposed to passcode protect your settings so you can’t remove apps/websites from the block list without the passcode. It fails miserably at that! Even with the app configured with a passcode, I’m able to change the block list, and that defeats the whole point of the app. I reached out to support to let them know of this and even offered to support with screenshots/video recording, but didn’t hear back.
Don’t waste your money on this app. It can’t deliver on the main features it’s supposed to provide and is a waste of your money.

reviews.title: If it ain’t broke don’t fix it
reviews.text: This was an amazing app and incredibly useful for what I needed. I could set up my custom rules and as soon as I opened the app it went right to the block page with single tap buttons to enable or disable them. Then a couple months ago they changed it so that when you open the app it goes to their stupid home screen, creating an extra unnecessary step. It was an inconvenience but manageable so I kept using it. Now they have completely redesigned the entire app for the worse, and now when I open the app it goes to the homepage, then I have to switch to the blocking page, and now they’ve taken away the one click buttons to enable them and I have to open the whole rule menu and scroll down and choose “turn on” at the bottom. Clearly these guys have never understood the phrase “ if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it.” I am now switching to a different app/service for my needs.
